translate_en|mods/CompanionCat/42/media/: Full watch over the whole sentinel range. A quiet growl for distant or few zombies; a loud hiss for close, many or visible ones, and that hiss can draw zombies (the trade-off). The default.
Your %1 hisses! A group of zombies!
Stealth watch: only a small nearby ring, and never more than a quiet growl and a halo, no loud hiss, no noise that draws zombies. A discreet heads-up that won't give away your position.
Bad for cats. Eating this makes it sick and breaks its trust.

Not a dog with worse numbers: an animal that simply does not have some of the jobs. A cat never fights the dead, is never posted to a pen, and only breeds with other cats. It hunts rodents and rabbits, and leaves deer alone. Your own animals are never prey: it will not touch a chicken, or anything in a pen. What it gives you instead is warning: it notices the dead further out than any other companion, and it is quiet about everything else. The hardest animal in the family to train, and independent with it: the bond fades faster than a dog's if you neglect it. Every so often it spots a rodent, drops everything and goes after it, ignoring your orders until it is done; only Come brings it back. Common in homes, and turns up at pet shops and veterinary clinics.

When on, your %1 tracks small game while following you and, once trained enough, chases it down: killing rodents and rabbits for you. Hunting is a rural activity (you find game in forests and the countryside, not in town). The cost is symmetric: the cat leaves your side and is exposed, the chase can draw zombies, it can wander off, and hunting works up an appetite. Off by default; toggle it per cat.
No record yet, visit this cat once
Your cat sees what you cannot. While it is fed, watered and bonded to you, the dark stops hiding what you are searching for: foraging at night works close to how it does by day.
Your cat is gone. The grief weighs on you, and it will only fade with time.
Your cat is hungry. Feed it before its health starts to suffer.
You slept soundly with your cat curled up beside you. For a while you feel calm and rested: panic, stress, sadness and boredom fade faster, and you tire more slowly.
You fed it something cats shouldn't eat. Your cat is intoxicated and feeling ill.
Your cat is thirsty. Give it water before its health starts to suffer.
Your cat is weak: it has gone a long time without protein. It obeys less.
Kittens that never grow up? Wish real life had that toggle :D
There is no record of that cat to call it back.
The cat yowls on purpose to pull zombies toward itself, then falls back to you. It costs stress, and the horde goes for the cat.

Hold an item and the cat memorizes it. Every time you sleep it goes out looking on its own and can come back with one, stowed in the saddlebags. Once a day, and the rarer the item the longer it takes. Needs saddlebags.
Hold the item you want the cat to look for.
The cat forgets what it was looking for and stops going out while you sleep.
Send the cat to a chosen tile and have it hold there.
Click where to send the cat. Right click cancels.
Hold an item and the cat memorizes its scent. From then on it warns you and goes to it whenever one is nearby.
Hold the item you want the cat to smell.
The cat forgets the memorized scent and stops warning you about it.

Scales how often stray cats appear in houses, shops and pet stores. 1.0 is the normal rate, 2.0 doubles them, 0 turns cat spawns off. This is separate from the dog spawn setting: turning stray dogs down or off no longer takes the cats with them.
